I eat out most days
en.how: Whenever there's no sink: before eating, after the commute, on the plane.
en.when: Every day it's needed, more on trips and in flu season.
en.watch: For when there's no soap, not instead of it. Keep it out of small children's reach.

zh.what: 随身免洗洗手液，找不到肥皂和水的时候用。
zh.like: 最好用的洗手液，是你身上带着的那瓶。车里一瓶、书包里一瓶，胜过家里放一瓶更好的。
who: 经常出门旅行
想给孩子书包里放一瓶
基本天天在外面吃
zh.how: 找不到洗手池的时候用：吃东西前、通勤后、飞机上。
zh.when: 需要的时候就用，出门和流感季用得更勤。
zh.watch: 它是没有肥皂时用的，不是用来代替洗手。放在小孩拿不到的地方。

en.what: Elderberry and vitamin C in a gummy.
en.like: A gummy actually gets eaten. When nobody will swallow the tablet, sticking with it beats a perfect formula.
who: My kids won't swallow pills
We're travelling soon
I just can't do capsules
en.how: At the same time every morning.
en.when: Every day through the season you need it. In the Cochrane review, regular vitamin C shortened children's colds by about 14 percent.
en.watch: It looks like candy, so store it where a child can't help themselves, and check the age on the label. A fever in a baby under three months, or one lasting more than three days, goes to a doctor.

zh.what: 接骨木莓加维生素C的软糖。
zh.like: 软糖是真的会被吃掉的。没人愿意吞药片的时候，能坚持比配方完美更重要。
who: 孩子不肯吞药片
马上要出门旅行
我真的咽不下胶囊
zh.how: 每天早上同一时间吃。
zh.when: 需要的那段时间每天吃。Cochrane综述里，规律补维生素C，孩子感冒的时间短了大约14%。
zh.watch: 它长得像糖果，要放在孩子自己拿不到的地方，先看清标签上的适用年龄。三个月以下的宝宝发烧，或者发烧超过三天，要去看医生。

en.what: Biotin, collagen and silicon for hair, skin and nails, which are built from the same raw materials.
en.like: Hair grows about a centimetre a month, so this feeds the hair that's coming in, not the hair you already have.
who: My hair and nails got brittle after a stressful year
I've been on a strict diet
My ends keep breaking
en.how: Daily.
en.when: In months. Hair needs time to grow out before you can see a difference.
en.watch: Be honest about biotin: real deficiency is uncommon, and the case for it in healthy people with hair loss is weak. Biotin can throw off lab tests, including a heart-attack test, so tell the doctor and the lab before any blood test.

zh.what: 生物素、胶原蛋白加硅，照顾头发、皮肤和指甲，因为这三样是同一批原料做的。
zh.like: 头发一个月大约长一厘米，所以它养的是正在长出来的新头发，不是你现在头上已经有的。
who: 压力大了一年，头发指甲都变脆了
节食节了好一阵
发尾老是断
zh.how: 每天吃。
zh.when: 按月来看，新头发长出来了才看得到差别。
zh.watch: 生物素要说实话：真正缺的人不多，健康人靠它防脱发，证据很弱。生物素还会干扰化验结果，包括心梗的检测，所以抽血前一定要告诉医生和化验室。

en.what: A shampoo made to cut breakage-related hair fall.
en.like: Most hair in the drain broke part-way down; it didn't fall out at the root. A shed hair has a small white bulb at one end, a broken one doesn't, and breakage responds to stronger strands.
who: There's more hair in the drain
I colour, bleach or heat-style a lot
My long hair keeps breaking
en.how: In place of the usual shampoo, every wash. Loosen tight ponytails too.
en.when: Every wash, judged over a few months.
en.watch: Losing 50 to 100 hairs a day is normal. A widening part or thinning temples is usually inherited pattern loss, which no shampoo reverses: send them to a dermatologist early.

zh.what: 防脱洗发水，针对的是头发断裂造成的掉发。
zh.like: 地漏里的头发，大多数是中间断掉的，不是从根部掉的。掉的头发一头有个白色的小球，断的没有。断发靠把发丝养结实，是有用的。
who: 地漏里的头发越来越多
常染、常漂、常用卷发棒
长头发老是断
zh.how: 代替平时的洗发水，每次洗头都用。太紧的马尾也松一松。
zh.when: 每次洗头都用，按几个月来看。
zh.watch: 每天掉50到100根是正常的。如果发缝越来越宽、两边太阳穴越来越稀，多半是遗传性的脱发，什么洗发水都逆转不了，要早点去看皮肤科。

en.what: Collagen in a gummy, the format people actually finish.
en.like: Skin collagen renews on roughly a twelve-week cycle, so this is a three-month product. The gummy is there so you're still taking it in week twelve.
who: I want to try collagen for the first time
I never finish a tub of powder
I hate swallowing pills
en.how: Daily.
en.when: Judge it at three months, not three weeks.
en.watch: For hair, the evidence is one small trial of specific peptides at 2.5 g a day, so hold it lightly. It looks like sweets: keep it away from children.

zh.what: 软糖型的胶原蛋白，真的吃得完的那种。
zh.like: 皮肤胶原大约十二周更新一轮，所以这是一个三个月的产品。做成软糖，就是为了第十二周你还在吃。
who: 第一次想试试胶原蛋白
粉剂从来没吃完过一罐
最怕吞药片
zh.how: 每天吃。
zh.when: 三个月再看效果，不是三周。
zh.watch: 对头发的证据，只有一项小研究，用的是特定的胶原肽，每天2.5克，所以别说太满。它长得像糖，放在孩子拿不到的地方。

en.what: The replacement carbon filter for Atmosphere air purifiers.
en.like: An unchanged filter is just a fan. The purifier only keeps working if the filter does.
who: I have an Atmosphere at home
I'm stuffy every morning
en.how: Swap it on the schedule the unit shows.
en.when: On the unit's schedule. Pick one day a week for bedding and filters, so it doesn't slip.
en.watch: The routine counts more than any one purchase: wash bedding weekly in hot water and keep indoor humidity below about 50 percent.

zh.what: 逸新空气净化器的替换碳滤网。
zh.like: 滤网不换，净化器就只是一台风扇。滤网在工作，净化器才在工作。
who: 家里有逸新净化器
每天早上起来鼻子都塞
zh.how: 按机器上显示的周期换。
zh.when: 按机器的周期。每周固定一天换床单、看滤网，就不会忘。
zh.watch: 习惯比任何一样东西都重要：床单每周用热水洗，室内湿度保持在50%左右以下。

en.what: An organic, real-food protein bar, made to replace the vending-machine snack.
en.like: Muscle can't bank protein. Most people eat a light breakfast, a modest lunch and a big dinner, and a bar mid-morning or mid-afternoon evens that out with no cooking.
who: My 3 pm snack is a pastry
I train after work and I'm starving by 5
I've got no time to cook
en.how: Mid-morning or mid-afternoon, in place of the sweet snack, with a glass of water.
en.when: Every busy day.
en.watch: A snack replacement, not dessert and not a full meal. Check the ingredients if there's a food allergy.

zh.what: 有机原料做的真食物蛋白棒，用来代替自动贩卖机里的零食。
zh.like: 肌肉存不住蛋白质。大多数人早餐很少、午餐一般、晚餐一大顿，上午或下午来一根，不用做饭就把一天的蛋白质分匀了。
who: 下午三点的零食是面包甜点
下班去练，五点就饿得不行
根本没时间做饭
zh.how: 上午或下午，代替甜的零食，再配一杯水。
zh.when: 忙的日子每天一根。
zh.watch: 它是代替零食，不是甜点，也不是一顿正餐。有食物过敏的，先看配料表。

en.what: Organic lion's mane mushroom extract, studied for nerve growth factor, not as a stimulant.
en.like: It won't feel like coffee, and it shouldn't. What people report is fewer word-finding pauses and steadier focus over weeks.
who: Words are on the tip of my tongue
I'm studying for exams
My memory slipped after 40
en.how: Daily.
en.when: Treat it as an experiment: give it a month, and keep it only if you notice a difference.
en.watch: The least tested option in the area: small trials, mixed results, and in one study the benefit faded once people stopped. Never say it fixes memory.

zh.what: 有机猴头菇萃取，研究的方向是神经生长因子，不是提神。
zh.like: 它吃起来不会像咖啡，也不该期待它像。大家反馈的是，几周后想词卡壳少了，专注更稳了。
who: 话到嘴边就是想不起来
在准备考试
过了40岁，记性变差了
zh.how: 每天吃。
zh.when: 当成一个小实验：给它一个月，有感觉再继续。
zh.watch: 这是这一类里证据最少的：研究规模小、结果不一致，有一项研究停了之后效果就没了。千万别说它能治记性差。

en.what: A honey and shea body wash that cleans without stripping the skin barrier.
en.like: With dry, itchy skin the bigger variable is usually the wash, not the lotion. A harsh wash strips a layer of barrier every day, and no lotion fully puts it back.
who: I'm itchy after every shower
My skin feels tight when I get out
I have eczema
en.how: Every shower, lukewarm and short, then lotion within three minutes while the skin is still a little damp.
en.when: Every day, including the days the skin looks fine.
en.watch: It's a gentle wash, not an eczema treatment. Weeping, crusting, hot or painful skin goes to a doctor, and keep using any cream the doctor prescribed.

zh.what: 蜂蜜加乳木果的沐浴露，洗得干净，又不破坏皮肤屏障。
zh.like: 皮肤干痒，关键往往不在身体乳，而在沐浴露。清洁力太强的，每天剥掉一层屏障，再好的身体乳也补不全。
who: 每次洗完澡就痒
一出浴室皮肤就紧绷
我有湿疹
zh.how: 每次洗澡用，水温调低、时间短一点，擦干后三分钟内、趁皮肤还微微湿就擦身体乳。
zh.when: 每天用，皮肤看起来没事的时候也一样。
zh.watch: 它是温和的沐浴露，不是治湿疹的。皮肤渗液、结痂、发烫发疼，要去看医生；医生开的药膏照常用。

en.what: A topical cream for a sore spot after training.
en.like: It works where you rub it and doesn't go round the body like a pill. That limits what it can do, and it also removes most of the worries people have about this kind of product.
who: My shoulder is sore after the gym
My lower back aches after training
My knees are sore after a long run
en.how: Rub it on the sore spot after training.
en.when: As needed, for comfort.
en.watch: Comfort, not repair: it won't speed recovery. Sleep, enough protein and no drinks after training do that. Sore for days every time means the load is going up too fast.

zh.what: 外用舒缓膏，涂在训练后酸痛的地方。
zh.like: 涂哪里就作用在哪里，不像口服那样进到全身。所以它能做的有限，但大家对这类产品的顾虑，大部分也就不存在了。
who: 练完肩膀很酸
练完下背酸痛
跑完长跑膝盖酸
zh.how: 练完涂在酸痛的地方。
zh.when: 需要的时候用，让它舒服一点。
zh.watch: 它是舒缓，不是修复，不会让你恢复得更快。真正帮恢复的是睡够、蛋白质吃够、练完不喝酒。如果每次都酸好几天，说明加量加得太快了。

en.what: XS protein plus workout support in one box, for starting a training habit.
en.like: Most beginners go all in during week one and quit by week three, because training burns through nutrients and nothing changed in what they eat. This handles the nutrition side, so the only job left is showing up.
who: I just joined a gym
I'm getting back into it after a long break
Just tell me what to take
en.how: Follow the routine above: protein at breakfast, the workout support around training.
en.when: Judge it after the first month of steady sessions.
en.watch: Protein supports training, it doesn't replace it. Kidney or liver disease, or a heart condition: see a doctor before adding protein or training harder.

zh.what: XS蛋白加训练支持，一盒打包，给刚开始养成健身习惯的人。
zh.like: 大多数新手第一周拼尽全力，第三周就放弃了，因为训练很耗营养，可吃的东西一点没变。它把营养这一半先安排好，你只管按时去练。
who: 刚办了健身卡
停了很久，想重新开始练
你直接告诉我吃什么就好
zh.how: 按上面的作息来：早餐吃蛋白，训练支持放在训练前后。
zh.when: 规律练满第一个月，再来看效果。
zh.watch: 蛋白质是支持训练，不是代替训练。有肾病、肝病或心脏问题的，加蛋白质或加大训练强度之前先去看医生。
